paragraph: [In March 2026 a joint WHO and HISP UiO mission found Angola's DHIS2-based national system serving over 4,700 users](<https://dhis2.org/pt-pt/angola-to-partner-with-hisp-uio-and-who/>). [In July 2026 the health minister called DHIS2 the main national health data platform](<https://pti.ao/angola-apresenta-estrategia-de-transformacao-digital-da-saude-na-oms/>). [Countdown 2030 gives national completeness of monthly facility reports as 71% of those expected in 2025](<https://www.countdown2030.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Angola.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 names a link to disease surveillance, the medicines supply chain or a register. Operating would need the national system linked to, or exchanging data with, disease surveillance, the medicines supply chain, or a patient or immunisation register.

[UNDP Burundi says the DSNIS uses DHIS2 as the sole system for collecting and sending health data](<https://www.undp.org/fr/burundi/actualites/pnud-verification-et-validation-des-donnees-tuberculose-pour-lamelioration-des-performances-des-services-et-soins-de-sante>). [Tuberculosis data checks ran in 16 provinces on 3-22 June 2024](<https://www.undp.org/fr/burundi/actualites/pnud-verification-et-validation-des-donnees-tuberculose-pour-lamelioration-des-performances-des-services-et-soins-de-sante>). [Countdown 2030 gives national completeness of monthly facility reports as 96% in 2025](<https://www.countdown2030.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Burundi.pdf>), with 84% of districts at 90% or more. No change has been found in the last twelve months. [In June 2026 OpenFn said a scheduled workflow takes HIV indicators from SIDAInfo, the HIV electronic medical record, and pushes them to DHIS2](<https://www.openfn.org/spotlight/automating-national-hiv-health-information-exchange-in-burundi>).

[In November 2023 Abt Global said the USAID-funded PSHPA trained private providers on national HMIS tools that feed DHIS2](<https://www.abtglobal.com/insights/impact-briefs/pshpa-trains-private-health-facilities-to-submit-rmnch-data-for-dhis2>). [It gave 4,000 registers to private facilities in all regions of Benin](<https://www.abtglobal.com/insights/impact-briefs/pshpa-trains-private-health-facilities-to-submit-rmnch-data-for-dhis2>). [The Ministry of Health combined these data with the public sector's](<https://www.abtglobal.com/insights/impact-briefs/pshpa-trains-private-health-facilities-to-submit-rmnch-data-for-dhis2>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the system is linked to surveillance, the medicines supply chain or a register. Operating would need the national system linked to, or exchanging data with, disease surveillance, the medicines supply chain, or a patient or immunisation register.

[In July 2026 Enabel said Burkina Faso has a decentralised national health information system (SNIS)](<https://open.enabel.be/en/BFA/2798/3690/u/analyse-et-utilisation-des-donnees-sanitaires-les-districts-de-dedougou-et-de-tenkodogo-renforcent-leurs-capacites-pour-mieux-decider-et-mieux-agir.html>) that collects routine data across the whole territory. [In September 2025 Africa Frontline First said the SNIS runs on DHIS2 as the national HMIS known as ENDOS](<https://africafrontlinefirst.org/2025/09/29/burkina-faso-is-scaling-up-digital-community-health-systems-through-a-national-roadmap/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the system is linked to surveillance, the medicines supply chain or a register. Operating would need the national system linked to, or exchanging data with, disease surveillance, the medicines supply chain, or a patient or immunisation register.

[WHO's 2024-2025 Botswana report calls DHIS2 the Government's selected gold standard platform for aggregate data](<https://www.afro.who.int/sites/default/files/2026-05/WHO%20Botswana%20Biennial%20Report%202024-2025_web.pdf>). [The minister told parliament that District Health Information System 2 is active and in use in health facilities](<https://dailynews.gov.bw/news-detail/89169>). He said it is not interfaced with the other systems to share data across all facilities. [In November 2024 WHO trained the ministry's informatics staff to run DHIS2](<https://afro.who.int/countries/botswana/news/botswana-strengthens-malaria-surveillance-systems-accelerate-elimination-efforts>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. Operating would need the national system linked to, or exchanging data with, disease surveillance, the medicines supply chain, or a patient or immunisation register.

[A poster by the health ministry's SNIS team says DHIS2 was adopted as the national platform for the Système National d'Information Sanitaire](<https://community.dhis2.org/t/dhis2-pour-la-reconstruction-du-snis-cas-de-la-rca/72669>) and deployed in all 35 health districts. [The poster states report completeness rose from 52% in 2020 to over 85% in 2025](<https://community.dhis2.org/t/dhis2-pour-la-reconstruction-du-snis-cas-de-la-rca/72669>). [HISP Rwanda says clinical data from the e-SENI hospital record are integrated into national systems, including DHIS2](<https://hisprwanda.org/hisp-emr-digitizing-hospital-care-in-the-central-african-republic/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. [In October 2026 the Institut Pasteur de Bangui called DHIS2 the central tool for the country's health data](<https://fr.linkedin.com/posts/institut-pasteur-bangui_dhis2-surveillance%C3%A9pid%C3%A9miologique-sant%C3%A9publique-activity-7516515814112534528-nGYz>).

[In September 2025 mHealth Africa said DHIS2, the national database known as SIGSANTE, is the backbone of the National Health Information System](<https://www.mhealth-africa.org/en/actualites/mhealth-et-dhis2-vers-une-interoperabilite-renforcee-en-cote-divoire/>). [It has centralised routine health data since its deployment in 2015](<https://www.mhealth-africa.org/en/actualites/mhealth-et-dhis2-vers-une-interoperabilite-renforcee-en-cote-divoire/>). [The mHealth community platform sends data to it through HL7 FHIR APIs](<https://www.mhealth-africa.org/en/actualites/mhealth-et-dhis2-vers-une-interoperabilite-renforcee-en-cote-divoire/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 gives the system's reporting completeness or timeliness. Mature would need the national system's reporting completeness or timeliness to be published.

[A 2026 preprint describes Cameroon's national DHIS2 instance, which covers all ten regions and 202 health districts](<https://doi.org/10.21203/rs.3.rs-11014186/v1>). Its malaria section was changed in 2024. [The health ministry's 2022 bulletin reported weekly facility reports from across the regions received in DHIS2](<http://onsp.minsante.cm/sites/default/files/publications/345/20230320_BEC2022_FR.pdf>), with completeness of 86.25% and timeliness of 76.6%. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Nothing found since October 2023 names a link to surveillance, the medicines supply chain or a register. Operating would need the national system linked to, or exchanging data with, disease surveillance, the medicines supply chain, or a patient or immunisation register.

[An April 2026 article says the national DHIS2 system is available in the DRC](<https://community.dhis2.org/t/surveillance-mpox-integree-a-dhis2-au-sud-kivu/71886>). [Health facilities send data through it, though often incomplete or late](<https://community.dhis2.org/t/surveillance-mpox-integree-a-dhis2-au-sud-kivu/71886>). [The DHIS2 organisation says the DRC has used DHIS2 as a national-scale HMIS since 2013](<https://dhis2.org/drc-ebola-response-2025/>). [A Countdown analysis gives DHIS2 reporting completeness rising to 99% in 2024](<https://data.gffportal.org/sites/default/files/2025-09/DRC--COUNTDOWN.pdf>). [RTI says the eIDSR disease surveillance system is integrated in the national DHIS2 platform](<https://www.rti.org/sites/default/files/documents/2024-07/Implementing_Real-Time_Disease_Stolka.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. Nothing found names a separate system that exchanges data with the national DHIS2.

[In October 2023 HISP West and Central Africa said Congo's national health information system runs on DHIS2](<https://hispwca.org/hispwca/?p=996>). [It feeds data in real time from 52 health districts to the central level](<https://hispwca.org/hispwca/?p=996>). [In August 2022 the ministry's health information director said DHIS-2 had been in place across the system since October 2018](<https://www.santetropicale.com/sites_pays/actus.asp?action=lire&id=32973&rep=congo>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the system is linked to surveillance, the medicines supply chain or a register. Operating would need the national system linked to, or exchanging data with, disease surveillance, the medicines supply chain, or a patient or immunisation register.

[The DHIS2 Climate & Health country profile, updated in July 2026, says Comoros has used DHIS2 as its national health management information system since 2022](<https://dhis2.org/climate/country-profiles/comoros/>). [In October 2025 DHIS2 said almost 99 percent of public health facilities in Comoros reported through it](<https://dhis2.org/supply-chain-management-dhis2-open-msupply-comoros/>). [DHIS2 says the eLMIS project, launched in 2024, links stock records kept in DHIS2 at facilities with Open mSupply at warehouses](<https://dhis2.org/supply-chain-management-dhis2-open-msupply-comoros/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 gives the system's reporting completeness or timeliness. Mature would need the national system's reporting completeness or timeliness to be published.

[On 4 September 2026 the project coordination centre CCIP asked for expressions of interest](<https://static.expressodasilhas.cv/media/pub/v2/pdf/2026/09/1788545549351.pdf>) from a firm to train health staff and managers over six months. The work is to support SIS/PORTAL and DHIS2, the health information system's digital tools. [In December 2023 the health ministry received 62 computers financed by the Global Fund](<https://minsaude.gov.cv/noticias/ccssida-entrega-a-direcao-nacional-da-saude-equipamentos-informaticos-financiados-pelo-fundo-global-para-reforcar-o-sis/>), to strengthen DHIS2 in health delegations and centres. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says a national system is in service. Establishing would need a national health management information system in service, with facilities or districts across the country reporting through it.

[In February 2026 UNFPA Djibouti said the Ministry of Health is adding gender-based violence case data to the National Health Information System (DHIS2)](<https://djibouti.unfpa.org/en/news/strengthening-governance-gender-based-violence-data-integrating-gbvims-health-dhis2-djibouti>). The Health Information Directorate runs the system. [WHO's management response of 14 April 2025 says DHIS2 is implemented at primary health care level](<https://cdn.who.int/media/docs/default-source/evaluation-office/management-response_evaluation-of-who-contribution-in-djibouti.pdf?download=true&sfvrsn=c96230e4_3>). It notes challenges in its use. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the system is linked to surveillance, the medicines supply chain or a register. Operating would need the national system linked to, or exchanging data with, disease surveillance, the medicines supply chain, or a patient or immunisation register.

[In January 2026 the Ministry of Health and Population launched DHIS2 as part of the national health information system](<https://dhis2.org/egypt-launches-dhis2-in-health-information-system>). A national DHIS2 training programme began at the launch. [In July 2026 the Egyptian Healthcare Authority said its health information system ran in 265 primary care units](<https://www.almasryalyoum.com/news/details/4321204>) and 166 other facilities, in the first universal health insurance governorates. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says a national system is in service. Establishing would need a national health management information system in service, with facilities or districts across the country reporting through it.

[In March 2024 a DHIS2 Community post said the Ministry of Health had deployed a national DHIS2 system across the health system](<https://community.dhis2.org/t/overcoming-connectivity-barriers-the-role-of-dhis2-platform-in-enhancing-health-data-management-in-eritrea/57621>). Data flowed from remote zones and sub-zones to central analysis. [In 2018 a WHO UHC Partnership activity supporting the DHIS-2 roll-out closed at 70 per cent implementation](<https://extranet.who.int/uhcpartnershiplivemonitoring/activity/eritrea-support-sector-digitization-and-dhis-2-roll-out-health-information-system-gaps>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the system is linked to surveillance, the medicines supply chain or a register. Operating would need the system linked to disease surveillance, the medicines supply chain, or a patient or immunisation register.

[DHIS2 and the Ministry of Health say the DHIS2-based national HMIS reached all 30,000+ public health facilities by 2024](<https://dhis2.org/ethiopia-healthcare-performance>). Full national implementation began in 2017. [In 2024 DHIS2's country profile said weekly notifiable disease data are integrated into the DHIS2-based emergency system](<https://dhis2.org/climate/country-profiles/ethiopia/>), and no source found says that system exchanges data with the HMIS. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 names a separate system that exchanges data with the national DHIS2. Operating would need the national system linked to, or exchanging data with, disease surveillance, the medicines supply chain, or a patient or immunisation register.

[HISP Rwanda says Gabon launched the DHIS2 platform at national scale on 6 December 2024](<https://hisprwanda.org/dhis2-officially-launched-in-gabon-hisp-rwandas-pivotal-role-in-transforming-health-information-management/>). [Gabon Media Time says the DHIS2 Tracker has been piloted in several health facilities](<https://gabonmediatime.com/sante-numerique-le-gabon-premier-pays-dafrique-francophone-a-deployer-le-dhis2-tracker/>) and is to reach four health districts by September 2026, with national rollout in 2027. [The eGabon-SIS project closed in June 2026 with the system in 13 civilian and military pilot hospitals](<https://www.gabonreview.com/egabon-sis-le-gabon-tourne-une-page-et-ouvre-une-nouvelle-phase-de-sa-transformation-numerique-en-sante/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says facilities across the country report through a national system. Establishing would need a national health management information system in service, with facilities or districts across the country reporting through it.

[On 29 October 2025 the Health Minister said the ministry had introduced the Ghana Health Information Management System (GHIMS) to replace the failing LHIMS](<https://www.myjoyonline.com/health-ministry-launches-new-digital-system-to-replace-failing-lhims-platform/>). In the last twelve months, [on 24 November 2026 he told Parliament that DHIMS is the public health information system](<https://www.myjoyonline.com/health-minister-directs-integration-of-dhims-and-ghims-to-unify-health-data-systems/>). He said he had directed that it be synchronised with GHIMS, the hospital system. [In October 2024 the Vice President said LHIMS was deployed in about 481 health facilities across all 16 regions](<https://gna.org.gh/2024/11/veep-launches-national-e-health-project-to-transform-ghanas-healthcare-system/>). No source found says facilities across the country report through DHIMS, LHIMS or GHIMS. Establishing would need a national health management information system in service, with facilities or districts across the country reporting through it.

[In 2025 the Ministry of Health's PASA2 page said SNIS data is entered on the DHIS2 platform](<https://pasa2.sante.gov.gn/activite-cle/gestion-analyse-et-validation-des-donnees-snis-dhis2/>). [It installed 77 solar systems in 7 regions and 33 health districts to power data entry](<https://pasa2.sante.gov.gn/activite-cle/gestion-analyse-et-validation-des-donnees-snis-dhis2/>). [The ministry says OpenClinic now runs in five facilities in Mamou and Dalaba districts](<https://lepandaguinee.com/2026/08/26/guinee-a-mamou-et-dalaba-le-pari-de-la-reforme-sanitaire-prend-une-nouvelle-dimension/>). Paper reporting into the SNIS continues alongside it. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the system is linked to surveillance, the medicines supply chain or a register. Operating would need the national system linked to, or exchanging data with, disease surveillance, the medicines supply chain, or a patient or immunisation register.

[DHIS2 has served as the Gambia's national health management information system since 2009, DHIS2 said in September 2024](<https://dhis2.org/strengthening-school-management-gambia-eswatini/>). [Smart Paper Technology, a paper-to-digital tool the Ministry of Health launched in 2017, scans health forms and syncs them with DHIS2](<https://articles.nigeriahealthwatch.com/smart-paper-technology-is-transforming-community-health-data-capture-in-the-gambia>). It was piloted at Bundung and Fajikunda and was expanding in December 2025, Nigeria Health Watch reports. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the national system is linked to disease surveillance, the medicines supply chain or a patient register. Operating would need the national system linked to, or exchanging data with, disease surveillance, the medicines supply chain, or a patient or immunisation register.

[DHIS2 says it has been Guinea-Bissau's national health management information system since 2011](<https://dhis2.org/hisp-to-strengthen-guinea-bissaus-national-dhis2-system/>), and INASA manages it. [The DHIS2 country profile dates its use as the national HMIS from 2013](<https://dhis2.org/climate/country-profiles/guinea-bissau/>). [DHIS2 Tracker programmes serve as electronic registries for maternal and child health and immunisation](<https://dhis2.org/climate/country-profiles/guinea-bissau/>), inside the same system. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 names a separate system that exchanges data with the national DHIS2. Operating would need the national system linked to, or exchanging data with, disease surveillance, the medicines supply chain, or a patient or immunisation register.

[EHAS says a first DHIS2 pilot ran from February to May 2025 in two districts, Baney and Añisok](<https://ehas.org/que-hacemos/sis/sis-guinea-ecuatorial/>). [UNDP reports the official launch of the DHIS2 platform at Baney on 1 March 2025](<https://www.undp.org/es/equatorial-guinea/noticias/lanzamiento-de-la-herramienta-digital-en-el-sistema-sanitario-de-guinea-ecuatorial>). In the last twelve months, [UNDP handed DHIS2 to the health ministry on 16 November 2026](<https://www.undp.org/es/equatorial-guinea/noticias/el-ministerio-de-sanidad-e-infraestructuras-sanitarias-refuerza-su-gestion-digital-con-las-plataformas-transdoc-y-dhis2>) and said the platform is implemented in 18 health districts across the country. No source found says districts across the country report through it. Establishing would need a national health management information system in service, with facilities or districts across the country reporting through it.

[A research team working with the health ministry used monthly facility data from the Kenya Health Information System](<https://www.gavi.org/vaccineswork/child-malnutrition-kenya-ai-model-can-forecast-rates-six-months-they-become>), covering January 2019 to February 2024. The system runs on DHIS2. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the system is linked to surveillance, the medicines supply chain or a register, or gives its reporting completeness. Operating would need the national system linked to, or exchanging data with, disease surveillance, the medicines supply chain, or a patient or immunisation register.

[A 2026 Vaccines article by CDC, Ministry of Health and UNICEF authors says monthly datasets from all facilities offering vaccination are aggregated at county level](<https://www.mdpi.com/2076-393X/14/4/323>). Data officers enter them into the DHIS2-based HMIS the Ministry of Health manages, which supplies national reports. [In March 2026 a West African Health Organisation pilot aligned regional indicators with Liberia's national DHIS2](<https://atlanticinfos.tg/2026/03/08/benin-waho-initie-la-mise-en-oeuvre-du-partage-automatise-des-donnees-de-sante-de-routine-phase-1/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the system is linked to surveillance, the medicines supply chain or a register. Operating would need the national system linked to, or exchanging data with, disease surveillance, the medicines supply chain, or a patient or immunisation register.

[In November 2025 Libya Review reported that the Ministry of Health and WHO met to assess DHIS2 digital reporting](<https://libyareview.com/60731/libya-who-review-expansion-of-national-digital-health-system/>). They plan to expand it. The ministry stressed continuous data entry from all health institutions. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the system is linked to surveillance, the medicines supply chain or a register, or gives its reporting completeness or timeliness. Operating would need the national system linked to, or exchanging data with, disease surveillance, the medicines supply chain, or a patient or immunisation register.

[In June 2026 an FHI 360 EpiC Lesotho tender named a national DHIS2 platform](<https://selibeng.com/epic-lesotho-consultancy-digital-health-and-data-analytics/>). It sought a consultant to support the ministry and district health teams in project districts. The consultant is to join the project systems LEAD, Infolink and DHIS2 Tracker to the national DHIS2. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says a national system is in service with facilities across the country reporting through it. Establishing would need a national health management information system in service, with facilities or districts across the country reporting through it.

[In August 2026 Santé Mag reported that the health ministry runs DHIS2 as its national platform for health data](<https://santemag.ma/sante-numerique-le-msps-passe-sa-plateforme-nationale-dhis2-au-crible/>). It is used in several national public health programmes, among them the HIV and tuberculosis programmes. The ministry is auditing DHIS2 from July to September 2026. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the system is linked to surveillance, the medicines supply chain or a register. Operating would need the national system linked to, or exchanging data with, disease surveillance, the medicines supply chain, or a patient or immunisation register.

[MTOMADY says DHIS2 is the ministry's national health data system](<https://www.linkedin.com/posts/mtomady_digitalhealth-interoperability-dhis2-activity-7381257757754150912-s2DE>). [Countdown 2030 gives monthly facility reporting completeness of 98% in 2024 and in 2025](<https://www.countdown2030.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Madagascar.pdf>), and the share of districts with complete reporting rose from 92% to 94%. [USAID ACCESS and Dimagi say CommCare feeds its data into the national health information management system](<https://msh.org/story/mobile-app-technology-improves-health-delivery-in-rural-madagascar/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. [In October 2026 HISP and the Data.FI project finished five months of work strengthening the national DHIS2 platform](<https://dhis2.org/hisp-centre-completes-dhis2-system-strengthening-support-in-madagascar-with-data-fi/>).

[In July 2025 Muso described DHIS2 as Mali's official national health data management system](<https://www.musohealth.org/post/towards-an-integrated-and-efficient-health-information-ecosystem>). [A health ministry deputy director said DHIS2 had also been made interoperable with DISC-Mali](<https://www.musohealth.org/post/towards-an-integrated-and-efficient-health-information-ecosystem>). In the last twelve months, [in November 2026 the pharmacy directorate restored automatic data transfer between DHIS2 and OSPSANTE, the health-logistics system deployed in 2014](<https://www.dirpharma.ml/index.php/fr/blog/interoperabilite-dhis2-ospsante-atelier-koulikoro-2026>). Transfer of facility data in batches began on 19 November 2026. No source found since October 2023 gives the system's reporting completeness or timeliness. Mature would need the national system's reporting completeness or timeliness to be published.

[DHIS2 says the ministry adopted DHIS2 in 2015 as SISMA, covering 161 districts](<https://dhis2.org/pt-pt/climate/country-profiles/mozambique/>). [In August 2026 MISAU said SIS-MA exchanges data with the medicines logistics platform of CMAM](<https://sisma.misau.gov.mz/interoperability.html>). It also exchanges data with the Ministry of Justice's SIRCEV death-certificate system. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 gives the system's reporting completeness or timeliness. Mature would need the national system's reporting completeness or timeliness to be published.

[In July 2025 the health ministry said DHIS2 is used nationally to collect and analyse SNIS health data](<https://elhadeth.mr/node/31262>). [The Countdown 2030 chartbook assesses national DHIS2 facility data for 2019-2024 by district and region](<https://www.countdown2030.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/MAURITANIE-Chartbook-Report-CAM-2025.pdf.pdf>). It reports that district report completeness is low against target. [In November 2025 Countdown to 2030 and APHRC trained district focal points to use SNIS data](<https://www.countdown2030.org/countdown-news/strengthening-the-use-of-srmnia-nutrition-data-for-action-in-mauritania>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the system is linked to surveillance, the medicines supply chain or a register. Operating would need the national system linked to, or exchanging data with, disease surveillance, the medicines supply chain, or a patient or immunisation register.

[In April 2026 DHIS2 said Malawi's DHIS2-based national system had been in use since around 2000](<https://dhis2.org/fighting-ncds-in-malawi-and-sri-lanka-with-the-diabetes-compass-project/>). [A DHIS2 profile calls it the ministry's national repository for health data](<https://dhis2.org/climate/country-profiles/malawi/>), covering more than 60 health programmes. [A climate project is deploying tools on the HMIS, starting in four districts](<https://dhis2.org/malawi-project-to-strengthen-surveillance-climate-sensitive-diseases/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the system is linked to surveillance, the medicines supply chain or a register. Operating would need the national system linked to, or exchanging data with, disease surveillance, the medicines supply chain, or a patient or immunisation register.

[Countdown to 2030 reports national facility data from DHIS2 for 2019-2024](<https://www.countdown2030.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/Namibia-Synthesis-Report.pdf>). [PTracker, the patient-level tracker for mothers and infants, submits its data to DHIS2 automatically](<https://informaticshub.ucsf.edu/node/116>). [The US CDC says it supports the health ministry with the national system, DHIS2](<https://dev2.restoredcdc.org/www.cdc.gov/global-health/media/pdfs/2024/11/Namibia-2024-Fact-Sheet.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. [In 2024, 96% of expected monthly facility reports arrived nationally](<https://www.countdown2030.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/Namibia-Synthesis-Report.pdf>), up from 86% in 2019, and 93% of districts reached 90% completeness or better.

[In August 2026 Data.FI said several digital health platforms are now connected to Niger's national DHIS2-based system](<https://www.linkedin.com/posts/data-fi-project_niger-dhis2-interoperability-activity-7493677620434288642-RoBC>).
